summary: At segment 0 step 7, do_name.c:docallcmd() dispatches the selected 'd' option to o_init.c:rename_disco(). The patched C recording draws the discoveries menu, while js/do_name.js stops at note_unported('o_init.c rename_disco()'), so the remaining menu selection and call-name input never run. Port the whole rename_disco() function in js/o_init.js and replace the refusal in the existing do_namecmd() caller.

source.branch: rename_disco() enumerates classes in flags.inv_order, keeps discovered types accepted by interesting_to_discover() and objtyp_is_callable(), groups menu entries by class, then calls docall() for a selected type.
callers: do_name.c:docallcmd() case 'd' calls rename_disco(); js/do_name.js:do_namecmd() already reaches the matching case and currently records the call as unported.
dependencies: o_init.c:interesting_to_discover() is implemented by js/o_init.js and has source-pinned discovery tests.
do_name.c:objtyp_is_callable() is implemented by js/do_name.js and has source-pinned tests in scripts/iactions.test.mjs.
o_init.c:disco_append_typename() and disco_typename() are implemented in js/o_init.js.
windows.c:add_menu_heading() and select_menu() map to js/windows.js; the menu display uses js/tty_menu.js.
do_name.c:docall() is implemented in js/do_name.js and owns the type alias prompt and discovery update.
